subject: Private pilot scheduling — Northern Biotech self-serve + SDR coordination
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@nbio.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@nbio.com, security@nbio.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:08:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Private deployment pilot for regulated workloads

Hi Soojin,

We just completed the self-serve signup form and selected the "Private/VPC" pilot option for Northern Biotech. We're evaluating Redwood for a regulated internal use case (PHI-adjacent), and compliance is the gating factor for us.

Can we schedule a pilot kickoff and a short preflight to run through evidence collection (SOC 2, data residency, log retention) and confirm whether on-prem will be required? Our CTO and compliance lead are available next week most days after 10am ET.

Quick context: we're trying to land a 6-week pilot (sandbox + sample dataset) and would like a calendar hold for an initial 45m technical walkthrough + 30m compliance preflight.

Links: I left a note in the intake form with high-level timeline and a couple sample files.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Cho
Head of Infrastructure
Northern Biotech

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@nbio.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment pilot for regulated workloads

Thanks for the note, Emily — welcome, and congrats on taking the self-serve step. I work on SDR intake and I'll coordinate the scheduling. A few quick asks to make the kickoff productive: 

- Could you confirm the preferred timezone for the team (ET/CT/PT)? You wrote "after 10am ET" which works; if any team members are APAC-based, we can split sessions.
- Who from your side will need access during the pilot? Please list names + roles (CTO / SecOps / App Eng).
- Any hard compliance blockers (e.g., absolute requirement for on-prem, dedicated HSM) we should know before the kickoff?

Proposed slots (ET): 
- Wed Aug 11, 11:00–11:45 (technical walkthrough + short Q&A)
- Thu Aug 12, 14:00–14:45 (alternate)
- Fri Aug 13, 09:30–10:15 (early slot)

I'll loop in our solutions engineer and security lead (Karthik and Markus) and we can attach a short SOC2 summary and a one-page pilot mutual action plan (MAP) ahead of the call. If none of those slots work, tell me two that do and we'll adapt.

Best,
Vivek
Account Development Representative | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@nbio.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@nbio.com, security@nbio.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment pilot for regulated workloads

Hi Vivek — thanks for the quick reply.

Confirmed attendees: 
- Aaron Park (CTO) — aaron.park@nbio.com
- Maya Singh (SecOps) — security@nbio.com
- Claire Winters (Platform Eng) — ops@nbio.com

We prefer ET. Of the proposed slots, Thu Aug 12 at 14:00 ET is best for the whole group, but if you have an earlier time on Thu morning we could try to rearrange. One important note: we need a short compliance preflight with a Redwood security rep prior to the technical walkthrough (30m). Can you do a 30m window on Thu Aug 12 at 13:00 ET for that?

Also: we need to see an abbreviated SOC2 evidence matrix before the call — high level is fine (what artifacts you can provide vs. what we need to collect).

Thanks — Emily

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@nbio.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment pilot for regulated workloads

Emily — great, Thu Aug 12 works. I'll send two calendar invites:

1) Compliance preflight — Thu Aug 12, 13:00–13:30 ET
   - Attendees: Markus Klein (Security Lead, Redwood), Maya Singh (SecOps, Northern Biotech), Vivek (SDR), Claire (ops)
   - Agenda: evidence matrix overview, data residency options, KMS/HSM integration notes, next steps for evidence collection

2) Technical walkthrough — Thu Aug 12, 14:00–14:45 ET
   - Attendees: Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng), Aaron Park (CTO), Claire Winters (Platform Eng)
   - Agenda: architecture for private/VPC and on-prem variants, pilot scope, sample dataset plan, runtime performance expectations

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (one-page summary), pilot-MAP-v1.xlsx (one-sheet mutual action plan). Please review before the compliance preflight — Markus will call out the top 4 evidence items we typically ask for so we can keep the pilot timeline tight.

If anything changes on your side I can move the invites; otherwise I'll send the calendar holds and a short preflight checklist. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
